resources.string: On-Device & AI English to Hindi Movie Dubbing
Select Movie (MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, AVI…)
Supports MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, AVI, 3GP, M4V, MPEG-TS, FLV, and OGV up to 2+ hours (with any Android-decodable audio track). Exported universally as Hindi-dubbed MP4.

Default On-Device Mode runs Vosk Speech Recognition, Google ML Kit Translation, and Android Hindi TTS right inside your phone (after a one-time ~70 MB model download). Zero paid API keys and zero rate limits.
You can switch to Gemini Cloud in Dubbing Settings or Studio Settings for cinematic AI voices. Cloud free-tier quotas (429 rate limits) only apply if you choose Gemini Cloud Mode.
AI Hindi voices use synthesized studio or on-device TTS presets (Male, Female, Neutral) and do not clone the original actor\'s voice.

Stereo Mid-Side + Speech-Band Suppression active. Preserves stereo music & SFX while attenuating center-panned English dialogue. Without a neural stem separator, faint centered reverb or mono speech may remain.
Mono audio track detected. Center-channel dialogue cancellation cannot isolate speech from mono mixes; speech-band ducking is used, so original English dialogue may remain faintly audible.
Shows progress while extracting audio, translating, and generating Hindi dubbing.
